description: Current mortgage rates grouped by loan type: rates RateZip observed on lenders' own published rate pages, each with note rate, APR, representative-scenario conditions, observation timestamp, source, and staleness status. No third-party national-average benchmark is redistributed. Loan types include '30-year fixed' and 'HELOC'. Pass loan_type to filter to one; omit for all grouped by type. Compare only within the same loan type. Factual rate data only: never estimate or invite a personalized quote, imply approval, or recommend a lender. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

credit_score.description: FICO — returns EDUCATIONAL context only; never a fabricated credit-adjusted rate

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

loan_amount.description: Loan amount in USD — flags conforming vs jumbo (does not fabricate a rate)

loan_type.description: Loan type to filter to, e.g. '30-year fixed', '15-year fixed', or 'HELOC'. Omit for all.

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/licensing note

name: get_mortgage_rates
title: Get current US mortgage rates
